cat > src/modules/contacts/zz-review.spec.ts <<'EOF'
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing'
import { MongooseModule, getConnectionToken } from '@nestjs/mongoose'
import type { Connection } from 'mongoose'
import { createInMemoryMongo } from '../../testing/mongo-memory.server'
import { ContactsModule } from './contacts.module'
import { ContactsService } from './contacts.service'

it('third search word is honoured', async () => {
  const mongo = await createInMemoryMongo()
  if (mongo.unavailable) return
  const m = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [MongooseModule.forRoot(mongo.uri), ContactsModule] }).compile()
  const s = m.get(ContactsService)
  const o = 'acct'
  await s.create({ firstName: 'Maria', lastName: 'Alvarez', address: { city: 'Oakland' } }, o)
  await s.create({ firstName: 'Maria', lastName: 'Alvarez', address: { city: 'Fresno' } }, o)
  const r = await s.listPaginated({ ownerAccountId: o, search: 'Maria Alvarez Fresno' })
  console.log('total for "Maria Alvarez Fresno":', r.total, r.items.map((c) => c.address?.city))
  await m.get<Connection>(getConnectionToken()).close(); await mongo.stop()
  expect(r.total).toBe(1)
})
EOF
pnpm test -- src/modules/contacts/zz-review.spec.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "total for|Expected|Received|Tests:" ; rm src/modules/contacts/zz-review.spec.ts
